name: Path of the Zealot

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A warrior fuelled by a god's fury: radiant or necrotic strikes, healing from divine reserves and wrath that refuses to die.

feature.name: Divine Fury
feature.summary: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn takes an extra 1d6 + half your Barbarian level Necrotic or Radiant damage.
feature.text: On each of your turns while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level (round down). You choose Necrotic or Radiant each time.

feature.name: Warrior of the Gods
feature.summary: A pool of d12s (four at level 3) you spend as a Bonus Action to heal yourself; it refills on a Long Rest.
feature.text: A divine entity helps you keep fighting. You have a pool of d12s for healing yourself: four at level 3, five at 6, six at 12 and seven at 17. As a Bonus Action you can expend any number of them, roll them and regain that many Hit Points. The pool refills when you finish a Long Rest.

feature.name: Fanatical Focus
feature.summary: Once per Rage, reroll a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus.
feature.text: Once per active Rage, if you fail a saving throw you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and you must use the new roll.

feature.name: Zealous Presence
feature.summary: Bonus Action: up to ten allies gain Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn; once per Long Rest or spend a Rage use.

feature.name: Rage of the Gods
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest take a divine form for 1 minute: fly, resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant, and keep allies from dying.
